What's your favorite way to cook a frozen pizza?

Middle oven rack with nothing underneath. Every so often I pop in an oven temperature gauge to make sure it's getting up to the proper temperature as thermostats can stray off track over time. A little olive oil brushed onto the crust. If there are no veggies on it I chop up fresh ones such as green peppers, black olives, onion, tomato, spinach, jalapeno, and some canned artichoke hearts. A dash of basil and oregano on top of the veggies and into the oven it goes.

Frozen: Lazy: some garlic and onion powder, bit of paprika, chili powder, and some fresh cheese Not lazy: fresh garlic and onion instead of powder, and the rest of lazy, unless I got something I want to try on half.

oven directly on middle rack

Pre-heat oven with a stone inside. While oven is pre-heating, I add extra cheese to the top to balance out the lava sauce. Then cook as usual.
